The structure of Ca2Fe12O20 (reduced formula CaFe6O10) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 38), with 34 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral and five-coordinate environments, Ca in an eight-neighbor body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, and O centers with four or five Fe neighbors. The Fe octahedra and five-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner- and face-sharing, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
